title.zh: 把蠕动挪进顶点着色器，省下的 1.1 毫秒
title.en: Moving the crawl into the vertex shader for 1.1 ms

summary.zh: 曲线烘成一张 2048 采样的半浮点贴图，相位变成一个 uniform。每帧不再重建 1610 个矩阵，主线程从 2.5 ms 降到 1.39 ms。
summary.en: The curve baked into a 2048-sample half-float texture, the phase reduced to one uniform. 1610 matrices stop being rebuilt each frame; the main thread drops from 2.5 to 1.39 ms.

zh: 每帧重建 644 个节点和 966 根连杆的矩阵，能不能整段删掉？
参数方程挪到 GPU 之后，画面会不会有可见的精度损失？
省下来的时间，用户在 30 帧的锁下面感觉得到吗？
en: Can the per-frame rebuild of 644 node and 966 bond matrices be deleted outright?
Once the parametric equation moves to the GPU, is the precision loss visible?
Under a 30 fps cap, can anyone feel the time that was saved?

verdict: 省了 1.1 ms，肉眼看不出来。真正的收益是把 1610 个矩阵从架构里删掉了——以后加节点不再让每帧变贵。
